payload.name: XAI Scaffolding Effect on Cognitive Load
payload.fact: Explainable AI (XAI) scaffolding significantly reduces cognitive load—primarily extraneous cognitive load—in students learning multilingual vocal works, compared to traditional AI-assisted methods.
payload.boundary: Conservatory of Music students learning multilingual vocal works (Bel Canto vocal music education).

provenance.title: Can explainable AI scaffolding reduce cognitive load and enhance embodied expression? A quasi-experimental study of multilingual vocal learning in Bel Canto education
provenance.quote_or_locus: The study found that the XAI scaffolding group's cognitive load reduction reached 38.9%, significantly higher than the control group's 17.0

provenance.title: Supplementary file 1_Can explainable AI scaffolding reduce cognitive load and enhance embodied expression? A quasi-experimental study of multilingual vocal learning in Bel Canto education.docx
provenance.quote_or_locus: the XAI scaffolding group's cognitive load reduction reached 38.9%, significantly higher than the control group's 17.0% (p < 0.001, d = 2.36, 95% CI [1.72, 2.99]), with extraneous cognitive load reduction of 41.2% being the primary contribution

decision_note: REJECT, NOT_TRANSFERABLE, delegated by owner. Grounded, but the population is multilingual Bel Canto vocal students in a conservatory programme and the intervention is scaffolding delivered inside that pedagogy. Both the setting and the expertise are unavailable to a general product user; nothing in the claim names an interface variable that outlives them.
